scope: Verification-only integrity checked against ISO 32000-2:2020 12.8.3 and locally registered RFC 5652, 5035, 3161, 4055, 5480, 5758 and 8017. Independent standard-library RSA/ECDSA signing supplies expectations. No trust, full PAdES conformance or timestamp clock validation is claimed.

requirements.description: Stream original signed ranges; select the signer certificate by issuer/serial or SKI; verify the content digest and DER attribute signature with RSA v1.5, PSS or ECDSA. Isolate signature errors and malformed certificate schemas. Report BER set ordering and weak SHA-1 separately.
requirements.gaps: Issuer matching currently requires identical DER names. Certificate paths, algorithm strength acceptance beyond reporting SHA-1, revocation and modification analysis remain unchecked. Globally invalid ASN.1 cannot isolate an embedded certificate whose element boundaries cannot be parsed.

requirements.description: Detached id-data and ESS signing-certificate v1/v2 signer binding (RFC 5035 sections 3-5); frame the CMS prefix and accept only zero PDF Contents padding. Link catalog Perms/DocMDP to its certification signature.
requirements.gaps: Complete PAdES attribute semantics, profiles, policies and historical signature discovery remain outside this integrity stage.

requirements.description: ETSI.RFC3161 document timestamp verifies both the TSTInfo messageImprint over signed PDF ranges and the token CMS digest and signature. The token requires an ESS v1 or v2 signer-certificate binding (RFC 5816 section 2.2.1).
requirements.gaps: TSA authorization, certificate path, timestamp clock trust, policy, accuracy, nonce and revocation remain unchecked.

requirements.description: When CMSAlgorithmProtection is signed, bind its digest and signature identifiers and parameters to SignerInfo. A mismatch is SignatureInvalid; malformed, repeated and MAC-only attributes are rejected. Accept permitted absent/NULL algorithm parameters as equivalent.
